title: Unknown Error 6 when restarting
body:
We've noticed that every time we get to the 9 days with our G6 the auto-restart feature fails. The sensor seems to stop but never starts. Our TSLIM:X2 shows the sensor as disconnected and Xdrip just shows signal errors. In the error log we see "Unknown error 6". The solution is to stop the sensor in Xdrip and then restart it with the code. Eventually it will connect again, do the 2 hour warmup and then be good.

None of these issues happen until the "pre-emptive restart" fires. I've uploaded the logs through the upload logs feature as well.

comments.body:
If your G6 is not capable to perform preemptive restart, you should disable it.  Otherwise, the sensor will stop on day 9 instead of day 10.
You can only use preemptive restart if the first two characters of the serial number are 80, or if they are 81 and the firmware version is not 1.6.5.27.
